summary_comment: Remote validation and submit flows use explicit discriminated state (`UsernameRemoteState`), refs for stale debounced requests and submit locking, and a dedicated `remoteApi.ts` with typed results—strong request/state modeling and reuse. Component boundaries are reasonable (API module plus an inline hook) but almost all UI logic lives in one large `App.tsx`, which is workable yet not ideal for separation. There are no automated tests or test scripts in the output despite edge cases (debounce races, 422/500, retry) that would benefit from them, so test coverage scores at the bottom of the band. Overall the TypeScript is readable and consistently structured.
